statements.t: Going forward, we expect new and recurring membership fees revenue from a growing base of members.

“We will continue to leverage Travelzoo's global reach, trusted brand, and strong relationships with top travel suppliers to negotiate more Club Offers for Club Members and add new benefits, such as our popular complimentary airport lounge access worldwide in case of a delayed flight,” said Holger Bartel, Travelzoo's Global CEO.
For Q4 2026, we expect year-over-year revenue growth.

We also expect revenue growth in subsequent quarters, as membership fees revenue is recognized ratably over the subscription period of 12 months, as we grow Club Members, and as more Legacy Members become Club Members.
Over time, we expect profitability to increase as recurring membership fees revenue will be recognized.
